patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Coralogix and Splunk Observability Cloud share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Coralogix and Splunk Observability Cloud share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Coralogix only if your buying job matches “Observability usage rate card — Logs $0.42/GB, Traces $0.16/GB, Metrics $0.06/GB, AI $1.50” rather than Splunk Observability Cloud's shape. Choose Splunk Observability Cloud only if your buying job matches “Splunk Observability Cloud — Infrastructure Monitoring from $15/host/mo annual; App & Infr” rather than Coralogix's shape. Workflow advantage differs because Coralogix is shaped for Observability usage rate card — Logs $0.42/GB, Traces $0.16/GB, Metric whereas Splunk Observability Cloud is shaped for Splunk Observability Cloud — Infrastructure Monitoring from $15/host/m. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Coralogix and Splunk Observability Cloud share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Coralogix is Observability usage rate card — Logs $0.42/GB, Traces $0.16/GB, Metrics $0.06/GB, AI $1.50/1M tokens; 14-day / 8-unit trial. No seat floor. ; Splunk Observability Cloud is Splunk Observability Cloud — Infrastructure Monitoring from $15/host/mo annual; App & Infra $60/host; End-to-End $75/host; free up to 15 hos.
- Company-size focus: Coralogix (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Splunk Observability Cloud (mid-market, enterprise).
- Researched limits: Coralogix — Does not outrank Datadog (8.6); Splunk Observability Cloud — Observability Cloud host SKUs are not Splunk Platform/SIEM ingest-GB pricing — do not mix floors.

Limitations — Coralogix: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6); No published seat floor — GB/token math still dominates TCO; Splunk Observability Cloud: Observability Cloud host SKUs are not Splunk Platform/SIEM ingest-GB pricing — do not mix floors; Does not outrank Datadog (8.6) as the observability cluster award.

Poor-fit cases: Coralogix is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6) · Splunk Observability Cloud is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Observability Cloud host SKUs are not Splunk Platform/SIEM ingest-GB pricing — do not mix floors · Avoid Coralogix if you actually need Splunk Observability Cloud's motion (Splunk Observability Cloud — Infrastructure Monitoring from $15/host/mo annual; )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
